about: Lane WORKSPACE's fixtures for SPINE: what the workspace lane sends and reads. A file under good/ must fit its schema; a file under bad/ must not, for the reason given. Written by scripts/make_fixtures.py of the lane; the schemas are lane SPINE's.

fixtures.shows: The folder the command line was launched from, sent as the default workspace; mode and base are the configured ones.
A worktree asked for explicitly, cut from a named base.
run.start carrying the workspace request, the field the workspace registrant declares.
A folder in no git work tree: the engine works in it; nothing is cut.
What the start registrant writes for a repository: the resolved folder, the base left to the worktree provider (the folder's HEAD), no worktree yet.
A folder inside a repository, with a base and steps as the request gave them.
The completed workspace a session view shows: source_path becomes path, the base is resolved to a commit and the worktree exists.
A direct workspace in a session view.
The run was given its folder, at launch, in the run's own log.
The run lost its folder once it ended.
A run that belongs to a session is logged in the session.

fixtures.rule: the launch record names the folder source_path, not path
a request cannot name the worktree
mode is direct or worktree when present
a completed worktree workspace names its worktree
the session view names the folder path, not source_path
only the core writes a grant
